pairs.flight: time-sorted names of the 937 posed images; a new flight starts where two consecutive capture times (from the name) differ by more than 60 s
pairs.overlap: share of view i's MVS points (export mvs map, every 4th pixel in x and y) that project inside view j's frame (prior-free, so both priors get the same pairs)

pixel.correspondence: the prior surface point of the pixel projected into the pair image; the pixel within +-2 px (5 x 5 candidates) with the largest max(0, NCC) of the 3 x 3 grey patches; ties (incl. all 0) -> the candidate nearest to the projection
pixel.grey: 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B (the paper's NCC is on intensity)
pixel.occlusion: ray from the pair camera to the prior point hits the prior surface more than 0.05 m before it -> not judged in that pair
pixel.frame: the 3 x 3 patch of the pixel and the 7 x 7 search window in the pair image must lie inside the frames
pixel.steep_not_judged: D1015-1: pixels whose prior surface has |n_z| < 0.5 are not judged (colour test and removed-building test)
pixel.colour: RMS over R, G, B (0-255) of the pixel and its correspondence

opening.factor_source: 10 / 14.2 (the paper's erosion size / relief displacement of 2 m)
opening.displacement: per pair: median over the judged pixels (up to 20,000, strided) of |(p_j(X + 2 m up) - p_j(X)) - (p_i(X + 2 m up) - p_i(X))|, the parallax change of a 2 m height change in that pair's geometry
opening.kernel: square k x k, k = round(0.7 x displacement); k < 2 -> no opening
opening.operation: opening (erosion then dilation) of the view's binary change image (judged and change = 1, else 0); the result is kept on judged pixels only

cells.view_vote: a paired view says 'change' for a cell when more than half of its judged pixels whose prior point falls in the cell are change after the opening
cells.cell_vote: change cell: more than half of the paired views that judge the cell say change, and at least 2 views judge it

removal.rule: per prior building region: every non-steep pixel (D1015-1) of the paired training views whose prior hit is on the building is re-projected through the ground height (ray / horizontal plane), its correspondence found as above (occlusion only by other buildings); if at least 95 % of those pixels (pooled over the views) have a colour RMS at or below the threshold, every plan cell of the building is a change cell
removal.region_ALS: vertex-connected components of the building_tri triangles
removal.ground_LoD2: median over the building's wall surfaces of the lowest vertex height
removal.ground_ALS: median centroid height of the ground (non-building) TIN triangles whose centroid lies in the 2 m band around the building's plan cells

growth.rule: search the cells within 1 m of the change cells; a searched prior cell whose median MVS - prior height difference exceeds 2 m in magnitude becomes a change cell; components of the new cells below 1 m2 are removed (D1015-2); then search within 2 m of the new change cells; a searched cell is not searched again; stop when nothing is added
growth.cell_dz: per cell: median over every training view's non-steep pixels (|n_z| >= 0.5, D1015-1) whose prior point falls in the cell and that have MVS of (MVS depth - prior depth) x ray z (the height difference along the pixel's ray)

size.stage: after the growth (the paper's end filter, 3.3)
size.extent: D1015-3: both sides of the minimum-area rotated rectangle (cv2.minAreaRect) around the component's cell corners
size.rule: 8-connected components of the change cells; kept when both sides of the minimum-area rotated rectangle are >= 2 m and the area >= 4 m2, and the median over its cells with MVS of |cell height difference| is >= 2 m; when more than half of its cells have no MVS the height is not seen and the component is kept (counted)

thresholds.update: per training view: a pixel whose prior hit lies in a change cell -> MVS depth (none -> empty); other prior pixels -> prior depth; pixels without prior -> MVS depth (none -> empty). The cell height difference of the growth and the size filter uses the non-steep prior pixels only (D1015-1, the 2.5-D top surface)
thresholds.filters: NDVI and road / river masks are not applied (no near-infrared image, no topographic map); the change area outside the evaluation range is recorded
